issues.display_title: Issue #114: Map Photographer Popup Should Close On Outside Click
issues.main_description_html:
Description

On the Find Photographers map, clicking a marker opens a photographer info popup (photo, name, location, "View Photographer" button). Currently, clicking anywhere outside the popup does not dismiss it. Users expect the popup to close when they click outside of it.

Current behavior

  • Click a map marker → photographer popup opens.
  • Click outside the popup (on the map or surrounding page) → popup stays open.
  • The only way to close it appears to be the small "✕" in the popup corner.

Expected behavior

  • Clicking anywhere outside the popup (map background, page, another area) closes it.
  • Clicking the marker / inside the popup keeps it open as today.
  • The existing "✕" close button continues to work.

Notes / context

  • Relevant area: src/components/pages/map/ (map surface + photographer popup card).
  • The map communicates via a postMessage bridge (mapContainer / mapPostsMessage) — verify whether the popup lives in the React layer or inside the embedded map iframe, since outside-click handling differs:
    • React layer: add an outside-click / dismiss handler (e.g. Radix onPointerDownOutside, or a useOnClickOutside hook).
    • Embedded iframe: the close-on-outside-click must be handled inside the map surface and/or via a postMessage event.
  • Ensure outside-click dismissal doesn't fire when re-selecting a different marker.

Acceptance criteria

  • Clicking outside the popup closes it.
  • Clicking the popup or its controls does not close it.
  • "✕" close button still works.
  • Selecting another marker swaps the popup without flicker/double-close.

Scenario Testing (for tester)

Pre-condition: open the Find Photographers map page and wait until markers are loaded.

# Scenario Steps Expected result
1 Close on outside click (map) 1. Click a marker to open the popup.
2. Click an empty area of the map outside the popup.		 Popup closes.
2 Close on outside click (page) 1. Click a marker to open the popup.
2. Click an area of the page outside the map (e.g. header/list below).		 Popup closes.
3 Stay open on inside click 1. Open the popup.
2. Click inside the popup (on the photo, name, or empty popup space — not a link).		 Popup stays open.
4 Controls still work 1. Open the popup.
2. Click the "View Photographer" button.		 Navigates to the photographer profile (popup behaves as today).
5 "✕" close button 1. Open the popup.
2. Click the "✕" in the popup corner.		 Popup closes.
6 Switch markers 1. Open the popup for marker A.
2. Click a different marker B.		 Popup for A closes and popup for B opens — no flicker, no double-close, no popup left stuck open.
7 Reopen after outside-close 1. Open popup, close it via outside click.
2. Click the same marker again.		 Popup reopens correctly.
8 Mobile / touch Repeat scenarios 1, 3, 5, 6 using tap on a mobile viewport / touch device. Same behavior as desktop — tap outside closes, tap inside keeps open.
9 Map interactions not broken 1. Open the popup.
2. Pan and zoom the map by dragging / scroll.		 Map still pans/zooms; an intentional drag should not be mistaken for an outside-click in a way that breaks normal use.

Source: user feedback (screenshot) on the photographer map popup.

RESULT

Implemented close-on-outside-click for the photographer popup.

  • src/components/main/maps/source/photographer/hooks/usePhotographerMapEvents.ts — call resetPhotographer() in handleMapClick when no photographer marker found at click point (closes popup on empty map click)
  • src/components/main/maps/ui/PhotographerPopup.tsx — add document.mousedown listener to close popup when clicking outside the map container (React layer)
  • src/components/development/maps/ui/PhotographerPopup.tsx — same fix applied to dev component
  • next.config.mjs — add apil.gothru.co to images.remotePatterns

issues.display_title: Issue #122: Integrate Countly analytics with per-domain app keys
issues.main_description_html:
Goal

Integrate Countly product analytics into the maps frontend using the official countly-sdk-web package.

Scope

  • Add countly-sdk-web dependency.
  • Root-level client component that initializes the SDK in the browser only.
  • Automatic session tracking, page view tracking on App Router route change, and JS error tracking.
  • Per-domain configuration: the app is served from several hosts, and each production host reports to its own Countly app key.
    • maps.gothru.co -> GoThru app key
    • maps.panorra.com -> Panorra app key
    • Any other host (localhost, *.local, dev/preview domains) reports nothing.

Notes

  • Countly app_key is a write-only ingestion key that ships in the browser bundle, so it lives in src/config/config.ts next to the existing domainSourceConfig rather than in env vars. A single build serves multiple domains, so env vars cannot select per host.
  • The Countly dashboard api_key is a real secret and must never be committed.

Pending

  • Fill in the two production app keys and the Countly server URL.

RESULT

Countly is live on development.

  • Added countly-sdk-web@26.1.3 (ships its own type declarations; the module is SSR-safe, it guards browser globals behind an isBrowser check).
  • New src/app/countly.tsx, a root-level client component mounted in src/app/layout.tsx. It initializes the SDK inside useEffect, so it never runs during SSR, and then calls track_sessions(), track_errors() and track_pageview(path) on every App Router route change via usePathname.
  • New countlyConfig in src/config/config.ts, keyed by window.location.host in the same shape as the existing domainSourceConfig:
    • maps.gothru.co and maps.panorra.com each report to their own app key, both against https://data.gothru.co.
    • Any host absent from the map never initializes the SDK, so localhost, *.local and preview domains send nothing.

Env vars were deliberately not used: one build serves several domains, so NEXT_PUBLIC_* cannot select per host. The app_key is a write-only ingestion key that already ships inside the browser bundle, so keeping it in config leaks nothing; the Countly dashboard api_key remains out of this repo.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit clean, npx eslint clean on the touched files, and the running dev server returns 200 with the Countly chunk present in the rendered HTML.

Not included, add later if wanted: track_clicks / track_scrolls / track_links / track_forms, consent management, request checksum via the SDK salt option, and excluding /embed routes from tracking.

issues.display_title: Issue #124: track: map lifecycle and zoom
issues.main_description_html:
Events

Event Location Segmentation
map_loaded src/hooks/useMapLoad.ts:13 (handleMapLoad) initial zoom (event.target.getZoom()), embed flag (window.self !== window.top)
map_zoom_changed src/components/main/maps/container/main/MapEvent.tsx:133 (handleZoomEnd) zoom bucket, whether markers/lines are above their visibility threshold

Why

map_loaded is the denominator for every ratio in the other tracking tasks — without it, a click count means nothing. Zoom is the strongest intent signal on this map, because markers and lines only render above markersVisibleZoomLevels / linesVisibleZoomLevels; the zoom distribution explains why users see an empty map.

Notes

handleZoomEnd fires on every zoom gesture. Send the zoom rounded to an integer bucket rather than the raw float, so the segmentation does not explode into hundreds of distinct values.

Depends on the trackEvent helper task.
